raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Depends on #45363. This branch is stacked on it, so only the last commit is new here; I will rebase onto `main` once #45363 is merged.

## Motivation

Follow-up to #45363, from @alexnails's [review comment](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45363#discussion_r4345591765) there.

`ExpertLocationMetadata.logical_to_all_physical()` compares a whole row of `physical_to_logical_map_cpu` with the expert id on every call, and the MoE weight loaders call it for every routed expert tensor during loading and weight updates. At the DeepSeek-V3 shape, that review measured 3.66 µs per call, about 0.3 s of lookups per full reload on each rank, and suggested building the lists once.

## Modifications

- The routed lookup reads a table: for each layer and logical expert, its physical expert ids on all ranks, in ascending order. Each lookup returns a new list.
- The table is built on the first lookup and rebuilt when the map tensor, its storage pointer, its `_version` or the logical expert count changes, so writes such as `update()` show in the next lookup. `TopKConfig.correction_bias_for_dtype` keys its cached copy the same way. The version is read before the build, and the key and the table are published as one tuple. Copied and unpickled metadata start without a table. The cache check is inline in `logical_to_all_physical()` rather than in a helper, to save a method call on every lookup.
- Inference tensors keep the row comparison, since writes to them may leave `_version` unchanged. This includes a map that turns into one through `.data` or `torch.utils.swap_tensors`.
- Map entries outside the logical-expert range, such as a `-1` in a hand-written `--init-expert-location`, are ignored as before.
- Unchanged: `update()`, the dispatch maps, the draft-layer fallback and the `require_global_experts` branch. For routed lookups within mapped layers, out-of-range and negative expert ids still raise `IndexError`.

The table does not see changes that keep both the storage pointer and `_version`, such as writes through `.data` or NumPy views, `torch.distributed` collectives, writes from another process through shared memory, or `map.data = map.t()`. Among the write paths in the tree that we checked, only `update()` writes the CPU map of a metadata object in use on GPU deployments; `kt_ep_wrapper` passes one row to an external library's `load_weights`, which we assume only reads it.

## Accuracy Tests

No model accuracy benchmark was run.

- `test/registered/unit/eplb/test_expert_location_weight_loading.py` compares lookups and loaded slots after `update()` of some layers, writes that bypass it, a replaced, transposed, swapped or copied map, inference tensors, a write during a lookup, and the bounds: 15 passed. The same tests also pass with the comparison-based lookup that this PR replaces.
- Together with the rest of `test/registered/unit/eplb/`, `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_presharded_loader.py`, `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_modelopt_loader.py` and `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_moe_wna16_ep_shard.py`: 130 passed, 2 skipped (both need a GPU), 106 subtests passed.
- Lint with the versions pinned in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, plus `scripts/lint/check_registered_tests.py`: clean.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured on GPU or end to end. A routed lookup now checks `is_inference()` and the cache key, then indexes the table, instead of comparing a row of `num_physical_experts` entries. The table is built in one pass over the map after it changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""Which physical slots the MoE weight loaders fill; no server, no model loading."""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=12, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import contextlib
+import copy
+import pickle
+import random
+import types
+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location import (
+    ExpertLocationMetadata,
+    _compute_logical_to_all_physical_map,
+    get_global_expert_location_metadata,
+    set_global_expert_location_metadata,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.fused_moe_triton.layer import FusedMoE
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import moe_wna16
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# EP 2, 4 logical experts + 2 redundant: rank 0 holds slots 0-2, rank 1 slots 3-5.
+# Logical expert 3 has both of its replicas on rank 1; rank 0 has none.
+SAME_RANK_REPLICAS = [[0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 0]] * 3
+
+# EP 4 on 2 nodes, 2 slots per rank. Expert 0 has two replicas on rank 0 and one on
+# rank 2, so rank 1 (no replica, node 0) narrows to a same-node replica.
+SAME_NODE_NARROWING = [[0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 0, 1, 3]] * 2
+
+# EP 2, 4 slots per rank. Negative entries (here -1 and -2) hold no logical expert.
+NEGATIVE_ENTRIES = [[0, -1, 2, 3, -2, 1, 2, 3]]
+
+# EP 2, 4 layers. Square: its transpose keeps the shape, storage and version count.
+LATIN_SQUARE = [[0, 1, 2, 3], [3, 0, 1, 2], [2, 3, 0, 1], [1, 2, 3, 0]]
+
+
+def _metadata(
+    layout,
+    *,
+    ep_size,
+    nnodes,
+    moe_ep_rank,
+    moe_a2a_backend="deepep",
+    ep_join_mode=None,
+    dtype=torch.int64,
+):
+    """What ExpertLocationMetadata.init_by_mapping builds on one EP rank."""
+    physical_to_logical_map = torch.tensor(layout, dtype=dtype)
+    num_logical_experts = int(physical_to_logical_map.max()) + 1
+    with get_context().override_server_args(
+        ep_size=ep_size,
+        nnodes=nnodes,
+        moe_a2a_backend=moe_a2a_backend,
+        ep_join_mode=ep_join_mode,
+        ep_dispatch_algorithm="static" if moe_a2a_backend != "none" else "dynamic",
+    ):
+        logical_to_all_physical_map = _compute_logical_to_all_physical_map(
+            physical_to_logical_map=physical_to_logical_map,
+            num_logical_experts=num_logical_experts,
+            ep_size=ep_size,
+            moe_ep_rank=moe_ep_rank,
+        )
+        return ExpertLocationMetadata._init_raw(
+            ep_size=ep_size,
+            physical_to_logical_map=physical_to_logical_map,
+            logical_to_all_physical_map=logical_to_all_physical_map,
+            moe_ep_rank=moe_ep_rank,
+        )
+
+
+def _random_layout(rng, num_layers, num_logical_experts, num_physical_experts):
+    """Every logical expert at least once, the remaining slots random replicas."""
+    layout = []
+    for _ in range(num_layers):
+        row = list(range(num_logical_experts)) + [
+            rng.randrange(num_logical_experts)
+            for _ in range(num_physical_experts - num_logical_experts)
+        ]
+        rng.shuffle(row)
+        layout.append(row)
+    return layout
+
+
+def _stand_in_layer(
+    *,
+    layer_id,
+    ep_size,
+    rank,
+    num_local_routed,
+    num_global_routed,
+    num_shared=0,
+):
+    """The FusedMoE fields and methods that the expert weight loaders read."""
+    layer = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        quant_config=None,
+        quant_method=None,
+        uses_expert_location=True,
+        layer_id=layer_id,
+        moe_ep_size=ep_size,
+        num_local_experts=num_local_routed + num_shared,
+        num_fused_shared_experts=num_shared,
+        _has_fused_shared=num_shared > 0,
+        _expert_storage_rank=rank,
+        _num_local_routed=num_local_routed,
+        _num_global_routed=num_global_routed,
+    )
+    for name in (
+        "_map_global_expert_id_to_local_expert_id",
+        "_local_routed_expert_ids",
+        "_weight_loader_physical",
+    ):
+        setattr(layer, name, types.MethodType(getattr(FusedMoE, name), layer))
+    return layer
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def _published(metadata):
+    previous = get_global_expert_location_metadata()
+    set_global_expert_location_metadata(metadata, allow_overwrite=True)
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        set_global_expert_location_metadata(previous, allow_overwrite=True)
+
+
+def _load_with_fused_moe(
+    metadata,
+    *,
+    layer_id,
+    rank,
+    num_local_routed,
+    num_global_routed,
+    num_shared=0,
+    require_global_experts=False,
+):
+    """Run FusedMoE.weight_loader for every checkpoint expert on a stand-in layer and
+    return {slot: checkpoint expert written there}; global slots for a global param."""
+    layer = _stand_in_layer(
+        layer_id=layer_id,
+        ep_size=metadata.ep_size,
+        rank=rank,
+        num_local_routed=num_local_routed,
+        num_global_routed=num_global_routed,
+        num_shared=num_shared,
+    )
+    written = {}
+
+    def _weight_loader_impl(*, param, loaded_weight, weight_name, shard_id, expert_id):
+        written[expert_id] = int(loaded_weight)
+
+    layer._weight_loader_impl = _weight_loader_impl
+    param = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(0), requires_grad=False)
+    if require_global_experts:
+        param._sglang_require_global_experts = True
+    # Shared experts first, so that a routed expert written over a shared slot shows.
+    checkpoint_experts = [
+        metadata.num_logical_experts + i for i in range(num_shared)
+    ] + list(range(metadata.num_logical_experts))
+    with _published(metadata):
+        for expert_id in checkpoint_experts:
+            FusedMoE.weight_loader(
+                layer, param, torch.tensor(expert_id), "w13_weight", "w1", expert_id
+            )
+    return written
+
+
+def _scale_up_layout(num_logical, per_rank):
+    """EP 2 -> 4 scale-up: the new ranks' slots repeat experts 0..num_logical-1."""
+    return [list(range(num_logical)) + [i % num_logical for i in range(2 * per_rank)]]
+

+class TestExpertLocationWeightLoading(CustomTestCase):

+    def test_lookup_follows_update_of_some_layers(self):
+        """Updated layers use the new slots; the other layers keep the old ones."""
+        old_layout = _random_layout(random.Random(2), 3, 8, 16)
+        # Rotating a row moves every expert: each lookup in an updated layer changes.
+        new_layout = [row[1:] + row[:1] for row in old_layout]
+        update_layer_ids = [0, 2]
+        expected_layout = [
+            new_layout[layer_id] if layer_id in update_layer_ids else row
+            for layer_id, row in enumerate(old_layout)
+        ]
+        metadata = _metadata(old_layout, ep_size=4, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=0)
+
+        def assert_lookups_match(layout):
+            for layer_id, row in enumerate(layout):
+                for logical_expert_id in range(metadata.num_logical_experts):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        metadata.logical_to_all_physical(layer_id, logical_expert_id),
+                        [
+                            slot
+                            for slot, expert in enumerate(row)
+                            if expert == logical_expert_id
+                        ],
+                        f"{layer_id=} {logical_expert_id=}",
+                    )
+
+        # Look up before update() too, so that a stale table would show.
+        assert_lookups_match(old_layout)
+        metadata.update(
+            _metadata(new_layout, ep_size=4, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=0),
+            update_layer_ids=update_layer_ids,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.physical_to_logical_map_cpu.tolist(), expected_layout)
+        assert_lookups_match(expected_layout)

+    def test_lookup_follows_a_new_map_or_expert_count(self):
+        """A new map storage, map tensor or expert count shows in the next lookup."""
+        metadata = _metadata(LATIN_SQUARE, ep_size=2, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=0)
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [3])
+        # New storage under the same tensor object; its version count stays.
+        metadata.physical_to_logical_map_cpu.data = torch.tensor([[3, 1, 2, 0]] * 4)
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [0])
+        # Another tensor over the same storage, at the same version count.
+        metadata.physical_to_logical_map_cpu = metadata.physical_to_logical_map_cpu.t()
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [0, 1, 2, 3])
+        metadata.logical_to_all_physical_map = torch.full((4, 5, 4), -1)
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 4), [])
+        # The map turns into an inference tensor, whose writes leave _version as it is.
+        with torch.inference_mode():
+            metadata.physical_to_logical_map_cpu.data = torch.tensor(LATIN_SQUARE)
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [3])
+        with torch.inference_mode():
+            metadata.physical_to_logical_map_cpu[0, 0] = 3
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [0, 3])

+    def test_lookup_follows_swapped_tensors(self):
+        """Lookups follow a swapped map, including swaps that overlap a lookup."""
+        metadata = _metadata(LATIN_SQUARE, ep_size=2, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=0)
+        cpu_map = metadata.physical_to_logical_map_cpu
+        for _ in range(3):
+            cpu_map[0, 1] = 1  # same values, a higher version count
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [3])
+        # The alias shares the storage but has an independent version counter.
+        alias = copy.copy(cpu_map.t())
+        self.assertLess(alias._version, cpu_map._version)
+        torch.utils.swap_tensors(cpu_map, alias)
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [1])
+        # Simulate a swap to an inference tensor right after the inference check.
+        with torch.inference_mode():
+            torch.utils.swap_tensors(cpu_map, torch.tensor(LATIN_SQUARE))
+        checks = iter([False])
+        with mock.patch.object(cpu_map, "is_inference", lambda: next(checks, True)):
+            self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [3])

+    def test_write_during_a_build_shows_in_the_next_lookup(self):
+        """A write that overlaps one lookup shows in the next lookup."""
+        metadata = _metadata(SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, ep_size=2, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=0)
+        cpu_map = metadata.physical_to_logical_map_cpu
+        writes = []
+
+        def write_once():
+            if not writes:
+                writes.append(3)
+                cpu_map[0, 0] = 3
+
+        def snapshot_then_write():
+            rows = torch.Tensor.tolist(cpu_map)
+            write_once()
+            return rows
+
+        with mock.patch.object(cpu_map, "tolist", snapshot_then_write):
+            # A lookup that overlaps the write may see either map.
+            self.assertIn(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), ([3, 4], [0, 3, 4]))
+        write_once()
+        self.assertEqual(metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, 3), [0, 3, 4])

+    def test_loader_fills_every_local_slot_with_its_expert(self):
+        """Every slot a rank stores gets the expert the layout puts there,
+        including a second replica of an expert on the same rank."""
+        rng = random.Random(1)
+        cases = [
+            ("same_rank_replicas", SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, 2, 1),
+            ("same_node_narrowing", SAME_NODE_NARROWING, 4, 2),
+            ("random_ep2", _random_layout(rng, 3, 8, 16), 2, 1),
+            ("random_ep4_2nodes", _random_layout(rng, 3, 8, 16), 4, 2),
+        ]
+        for name, layout, ep_size, nnodes in cases:
+            per_rank = len(layout[0]) // ep_size
+            for rank in range(ep_size):
+                with self.subTest(name, rank=rank):
+                    metadata = _metadata(
+                        layout, ep_size=ep_size, nnodes=nnodes, moe_ep_rank=rank
+                    )
+                    for layer_id, row in enumerate(layout):
+                        written = _load_with_fused_moe(
+                            metadata,
+                            layer_id=layer_id,
+                            rank=rank,
+                            num_local_routed=per_rank,
+                            num_global_routed=len(row),
+                        )
+                        own = row[rank * per_rank : (rank + 1) * per_rank]
+                        self.assertEqual(written, dict(enumerate(own)))

+    def test_static_dispatch_only_targets_loaded_slots(self):
+        """No rank's static dispatch table sends an expert's tokens to a slot that
+        its owner left unloaded or loaded with another expert."""
+        all_metadata = [
+            _metadata(SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, ep_size=2, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=rank)
+            for rank in range(2)
+        ]
+        per_rank = all_metadata[0].num_local_physical_experts
+        for rank, metadata in enumerate(all_metadata):
+            table = metadata.logical_to_rank_dispatch_physical_map.tolist()
+            for layer_id, row in enumerate(table):
+                for logical_expert_id, slot in enumerate(row):
+                    owner = slot // per_rank
+                    written = _load_with_fused_moe(
+                        all_metadata[owner],
+                        layer_id=layer_id,
+                        rank=owner,
+                        num_local_routed=per_rank,
+                        num_global_routed=per_rank * 2,
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        written.get(slot - owner * per_rank),
+                        logical_expert_id,
+                        f"{rank=} {layer_id=} {logical_expert_id=}",
+                    )
